about: Explainer film, batch 2: review fixes. Framed, verified 1920 x 1080 re-renders at 20 frames a second. Straight down ('top'), the arm hides the cream cheese while the hand works it, so the job-2 overhead clips are also drawn from 'top-tilt', 25 degrees off vertical from the front left, the robot still at the top (fleetlab.film.framing.POSES). Rendered with: tools/heavy-run --light -m 4G uv run --locked python -m fleetlab.film frame --clips site/explainer/clips-batch-2.json --out ~/.cache/robots-probes/demo/explainer/footage/batch-2
